svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Cluster prod-eu-1 as a 3D city (L2 Cluster → L3 Node, INC-2041)
svg.desc: Perspective 3D city of the cluster prod-eu-1 at ladder level L2. Forty nodes stand as buildings on street blocks grouped into node-pool districts (general, memory, gpu, system) with ground-painted district labels. Footprint encodes allocatable capacity and, with the Capacity layer on, height encodes memory used ÷ request; each floor slab is a pod. The node ip-10-4-9-17 in pool memory is cut away as an exploded stack: pods are slabs, containers are cells, and it is Degraded under MemoryPressure with batch-etl overflowing its slab at 2.4× request. The building hosting the psp-api client pods glows Failing with the ⊕ origin beacon; two nodes running checkout are desaturated victims with dashed ground rings. A translucent HUD carries the top bar, view switcher with City active, layer chips with Capacity active and a height legend, the Orbit · Map · Fly chip, an altitude ladder with L2 lit and L3 on approach, a cluster header strip, a minimap, an orbit compass, an Inspector for ip-10-4-9-17 and the Time Ribbon.

g.text: RCA: infra ruled out for INC-2041 ✖
